ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) across the basal and central fluke regions, with approximately 25-30% high-intensity (white) pixel clusters localized at the distal tips and sub-terminal trailing edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous low-intensity region spanning the peduncle and central lobes. High-intensity geometric blobs (mottling) are mapped to the outer distal tips of both lobes and along the trailing margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide, U-shaped central depression; calculated interior angle at the vertex is approximately 125 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude variations (serrations) across the entire boundary; presence of a deep, non-periodic indentation on the trailing edge of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve fitted to the leading margins, tapering to sharp distal tips with an upward sweep relative to the horizontal plane.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Discrete clusters of small, high-contrast white pixels visible against the dark background on the central-right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple parallel, vertical high-contrast linear disruptions (rake marks) on the upper-right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Vertical rake marks on the right lobe; irregular notch/tissue loss on the trailing edge of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct high-intensity white border tracing the contour of the distal trailing edge of the right lobe.
